errors.evidence: The x-axis represents time (years 2016 to 2024), not index values. The description incorrectly swaps the x- and y-axis roles.

The description does not state that the chart illustrates the development of indices in economic, financial, and trade policy over time, as highlighted in the reference.
The description omits the right y-axis scale (0 to 9000) and its association with the Handelspolitik line.
The description incorrectly describes the x-axis as representing index values instead of years. The reference explicitly states the x-axis represents years from 2016 to 2024.
The description omits the sharp rise of the Handelspolitik line to 8000 in 2024-2025, a key feature mentioned in the reference.
The description does not mention that the black and blue lines use the left y-axis scale, while the purple line uses the right y-axis scale, as specified in the reference.
